# AesCode Co.
> India's MedTech innovation platform and Clinical AI validation infrastructure. Founded in 2026 by Nikhil Gour. Organizer of the AesCode MedTech Hackathon (Cohort 1), held at Bharati Vidyapeeth Medical College, Pune.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://www.aescode.nexus/ — Clinical AI validation infrastructure overview
- About: https://www.aescode.nexus/about — Mission, origin, and research methodology
- Cohort 1 (MedTech Hackathon): https://www.aescode.nexus/cohort1 — National MedTech Hackathon details, judges, mentors, outcomes
- Meet the Team: https://www.aescode.nexus/meet-the-team — Founders and organising team
- AI Ethics: https://www.aescode.nexus/ai-ethics — DPDP / ICMR / CDSCO-aligned governance
- Special Thanks: https://www.aescode.nexus/special-thanks — Clinical and academic mentors
- Contact: https://www.aescode.nexus/contact — Partnerships, research, and press

## About the Founder
Nikhil Gour is the Founder & CEO of AesCode Co., a 19-year-old gap-year builder focused on Clinical AI, MedTech infrastructure, and health innovation in India. He also leads Care & Beyond and Inwest.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil-gour-aescode
- GitHub: https://github.com/futureworksnik-lab

## Topics Covered
Clinical AI, Clinical AI Validation, AI as a Medical Device, MedTech Hackathon, India Health AI Infrastructure, Federated Learning on hospital data.

## Credibility
Partners: KCDH, IIT Bombay; Bharati Vidyapeeth (DU) Medical College & Bharati Hospital, Pune.
